info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Refinances-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of a list of available mortgage loan refinancing options. It serves financial institutions, mortgage brokers, and developers seeking to provide clients with data on refinancing products. Users can access detailed information about various refinancing loans, enabling them to make informed decisions. The API supports efficient queries for finding suitable mortgage refinancing solutions that meet diverse customer needs.

get.description: Fetch the available refinancing options for different types of loans. This endpoint allows users to explore their refinancing options, helping them make informed financial decisions.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating a loan refinance operation. This body should contain the necessary parameters for processing the refinance request.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesRequest.description: The request body for the refinance operations when fetching loan details.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_202.title: Refinance Loan Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful or not.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number assigned to the loan request.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the loan request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's result.

audit.description: Contains information about the audit trail of the operation.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_202.description: Response object for the refinance loan operation, indicating the status and details of the request.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details regarding the audit information of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can be useful for performance monitoring and troubleshooting.
